items.stem: A note on a structural drawing conflicts with the written specification. Which document generally governs when the contract sets a precedence order favouring specifications?

options.text: The specification, because the contract's order of precedence resolves the conflict
options.rationale: Correct: the contract's precedence clause decides; here specifications govern.
Issue date does not override a stated precedence order.

options.text: The drawing, because drawings always win
options.rationale: Drawings do not automatically govern; the contract sets precedence.
Conflicts are resolved by precedence and RFIs, not by stopping work.

items.explanation: Correct: the contract's precedence clause decides; here specifications govern.

items.stem: Which TWO are typically the owner's responsibilities rather than the general contractor's? (Select TWO.)

options.rationale: Correct: arranging funding is an owner responsibility.

options.text: Defining the project program and budget
options.rationale: Correct: the owner sets the program and budget.
Means and methods, including trade sequencing, are the contractor's.
Daily supervision of crews is the contractor's role.

items.explanation: Correct: arranging funding is an owner responsibility.

items.stem: An owner wants to overlap design and construction to finish sooner on a warehouse with a well-understood scope. Which delivery method best supports this?

options.text: Design-build, which integrates design and construction under one entity to enable fast-tracking
options.rationale: Correct: design-build supports overlapping design and construction.

options.text: Traditional design-bid-build with full design before bidding
options.rationale: That sequences design fully before construction, slowing delivery.
Operating without a contract is not a delivery method and is high risk.

options.text: Waiting until all permits are closed before any design
options.rationale: This delays rather than accelerates delivery.

items.explanation: Correct: design-build supports overlapping design and construction.
